title: Origins Drakkon
description: The official Drakkon origin from the Lornwood SMP
body:
# The Drakkon Origin 

## The official Origin from the Lornwood SMP now in its Public State

Reminder this Origin is not the same as in the Lornwood SMP this Origin has been cleaned up for public use so some things might be tweaked a bit.

### Origin Info 
For ingame view check the Gallery for a cleaner view 

Drakkons are well adapted to life in the nether. They are cold blooded creatures which appear predatorial and cunning, likewise their movements are smooth and precise. They are more attuned to mana than most mortals, having studied the natural magic use of dragons for centuries.

### Brittle Armor
The way you absorb mana makes armor less protective

### Charred Palate
Your lineage's unique gastronomic necessities have made it so you can only eat foods that have been touched by flame, as well as other processed consumeables.

### Fire Blast
Your species has studied the use of magic for centuries, and have a grasp on natural elemental abilities linked to mana. Throw balls of fire fueled by your limited supply of personal mana, recovering that mana over time

### Frigid Vulnerability
Your unfamiliarity with the cold has led you to become quite susceptible to ice and freezing damage.

### Ignition
Your infernal anatomy causes those you attack to be set ablaze.

### Keepsake
Your multitude of appendages have expanded your inventory's capabilities, allowing you to access an extra five new item slots that spill their contents on death.

### Poor Circulation
The way in which your body circulates blood makes you highly vulnerable to all forms of water. If contact occurs, the heat kept inside your body will be sapped right out, causing continuous freezing damage.

### Steaming
Your body radiates a faint steam when in colder climates.

### Love for Warmth
You are a cold blooded creature, and need extreme warmth to thrive. In cold biomes, you feel tired and sluggish.
